# Risky areas (§19, Zeus 2026-11-07): a builder PR into `staging` that touches one of these needs a Cerberus pass before
# it merges; everything else waits for the batch review into `main`. Auth, workspace isolation (RLS and tenancy),
# billing, uploads, website fetching and AI prompts, because later tasks copy a hole here. The merge gate always reads
# this file from `main`; without it, every staging PR needs Cerberus. Patterns ignore letter case.

packages/db/**              tests/tenancy/**                    config/plans.ts
packages/storage/**         apps/fetcher/**                     apps/web/src/app/r/**
packages/ai/prompts/**      packages/ai/policy/**               config/models.ts            config/providers.ts
